base_commit_note: Squash-merge. Patches use gh API (with previous_filename for renamed RemoteCalcCallFinder→RemoteCallFinder + DelegatingResultFuture→DelegatingAsyncTableResultFuture).

triage.test_level_policy: All augmented F2P selectors drive AsyncTableFunction through TableEnvironment or SQL correlate execution in flink-table-planner IT cases. The augmented P2P selectors exercise unchanged flink-clients CLI parsing and ProgramOptions-to-Configuration behavior. No augmented selector calls a production private helper; local fixture functions are test-only public UDFs.

org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Pins the public async-table option names and verifies they are distinct from the async-scalar option family described by FLIP-498.

org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: TableEnvironment configuration plus SQL LATERAL TABLE execution of an AsyncTableFunction.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Distinguishes async-table timeout handling from async-scalar timeout handling by running a table function that completes after the scalar timeout but before the async-table timeout.

org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL LATERAL TABLE execution of an AsyncTableFunction with concurrent async results that complete out of input order.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Pins FLIP-498's ordered async correlate behavior by making the second async result complete first and requiring SQL output to preserve input order.

org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: Temporary system function registration validation for AsyncTableFunction eval signatures.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Verifies the public validation contract that AsyncTableFunction eval methods must use a CompletableFuture of a collection result.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Split Rules
Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: TableEnvironment EXPLAIN plus SQL execution of an AsyncTableFunction with a hinted multi-field Row output and a projected input operand.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Forces the remote correlate split path to preserve the original async table call type while planner utilities detect the async-table kind through a public SQL query.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL LATERAL TABLE execution of an AsyncTableFunction whose atomic STRING output is bridged to Flink's internal StringData representation.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Pins the documented implicit row wrapping behavior for non-Row async table outputs, including the internal representation path used by generated async correlate code.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL projection over the column produced by an AsyncTableFunction with internally bridged atomic STRING output.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Checks that generated async correlate code exposes atomic table outputs as logical one-field rows so downstream public SQL projections can use the produced column.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Split Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.plan.rule.public_surface: Planner SQL query verification for an AsyncTableFunction correlate whose operand contains a scalar function.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.plan.rule.rationale: Uses the PR's SQL plan test surface to verify async-table split rules detect async table calls and preserve call typing when operands are projected.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Split Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.plan.rule.public_surface: Planner SQL query verification for an AsyncTableFunction correlate whose operand contains nested casts.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.plan.rule.rationale: Exercises the same split-rule path with a system-expression operand so call type preservation is required across a rebuilt RexCall.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.public_surface: Generated async correlate function invoked from a SQL expression over public AsyncTableFunction inputs.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.rationale: Verifies non-Row async table outputs are wrapped as one-field rows by generated async correlate code instead of being forwarded as raw atomic values.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.public_surface: Generated async correlate function invoked from a SQL expression with an explicit Row output hint.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.rationale: Pins logical Row return typing through generated async table calls so hinted multi-field rows are not treated as atomic outputs.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.public_surface: Generated async correlate function invoked from a SQL expression with an internal RowData output bridge.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.rationale: Verifies generated async correlate code preserves internal RowData results and does not replace wrapped internal values with null.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.public_surface: Generated async table function call for a public AsyncTableFunction signature with internal STRING bridging.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.codegen.A.rationale: Directly asserts the generated expression retains the logical one-field Row return type required by async table scans instead of exposing the physical atomic output type.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL LATERAL TABLE invocation of a zero-argument AsyncTableFunction.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Covers the public async table function catalog path and generated correlate output wrapping for a constant table function without input arguments.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Runtime Changes > Code Generation
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL LATERAL TABLE invocation of an AsyncTableFunction with explicit Row output type hints.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Exercises FLIP-498's documented type-hint path for Row outputs and verifies generated async table results preserve the hinted row shape.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Split Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL query containing AsyncTableFunction correlate plus an async calc expression.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Covers the planner split rules that isolate async calls around correlates and the runtime path for mixed async-table and async-calc execution.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Physical Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL correlate with right-side calculation selected through the table planner and runtime operator.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Ensures async table correlates match the physical async rule set and preserve joined row ordering when the right side is projected as a full row.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Physical Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL validation/planning of an AsyncTableFunction correlate with unsupported right-side projection.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Pins the documented limitation that async correlates reject projections on the right side instead of silently planning an unsupported shape.

requirement_sections: Proposed Changes > Planner Changes > Physical Rules
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.public_surface: SQL validation/planning of an AsyncTableFunction correlate with unsupported right-side conditions.
org.apache.flink.table.planner.runtime.s.rationale: Pins the companion unsupported-condition path so physical async correlate planning cannot accept filters the runtime does not support.

org.apache.flink.client.cli.ClientCliAug.public_surface: CliFrontendParser RUN_OPTIONS and ProgramOptions public option-to-Configuration flow.
org.apache.flink.client.cli.ClientCliAug.rationale: Pins unchanged flink-clients attached-run CLI semantics so async-table planner changes do not mask collateral regressions in a separate build module.

org.apache.flink.client.cli.ClientCliAug.public_surface: CliFrontendParser detached RUN_OPTIONS and ProgramOptions public option-to-Configuration flow.
org.apache.flink.client.cli.ClientCliAug.rationale: Pins detached execution and shutdown-on-attached-exit parsing as independent unchanged CLI behavior.

fail_to_pass._summary: 6 AsyncCorrelateITCase tests driving AsyncTableFunction end-to-end via MiniCluster.

pass_to_pass._summary: 50 untouched flink-clients selectors covering client options, packaged-program utilities, application entrypoint parsing, CLI dynamic properties, frontend info/list handling, and cluster-client service loading. They do not import or compile-depend on async-table planner/runtime classes, so they pass in both pre- and post-patch states.
